adjudication.rationale: In the diff, `parseRefreshTokenResponse` (new file) calls `safeParse(...)` and immediately `throw new Error(...)` when `!refreshTokenResponse.success`, so callers will never see a `{ success: false }` result. However, `office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts` still does `...(tokenResponse.success && tokenResponse.data)` after switching to `parseRefreshTokenResponse(...)`, and `salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts` still checks `if (!accessTokenParsed.success)` after calling `parseRefreshTokenResponse(...)`; both branches are now effectively dead/redundant. Office365 also removed the prior explicit logging-on-parse-failure path, so the failure mode is now an exception rather than logging and continuing, but that change is visible and may be intentional rather than a clear defect.
